requirement.text: If the current temperature value is strictly less than the lower value of the valid temperature range or if the received temperature value is strictly greater than the upper value of the valid temperature range, then the THEMAS system shall identify the current temperature value as an invalid temperature and shall output an invalid temperature status.

classification.rationale: The requirement describes explicit, rule-based range validation for temperature readings within the THEMAS system, which represents a physical/embedded control system or general backend service rather than a web application, mobile app, or AI/ML-driven model.

rounds.text_checked: If the current temperature value is strictly less than the lower value of the valid temperature range or if the received temperature value is strictly greater than the upper value of the valid temperature range, then the THEMAS system shall identify the current temperature value as an invalid temperature and shall output an invalid temperature status.

test_strategy.rationale: Equivalence partitioning applies because the requirement specifies numeric ranges and partitions temperatures into valid and invalid categories (strictly less than lower bound, within valid range, and strictly greater than upper bound). Boundary value analysis applies to test the exact threshold points around the lower and upper limits of the valid temperature range to ensure correct handling of strictly less than and strictly greater than conditions. Decision table testing applies because multiple conditional comparisons (less than lower bound OR greater than upper bound) drive the output status behavior.

test_cases.title: Temperature strictly less than valid lower bound
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is configured with a valid temperature range of 0.0°C (lower) to 100.0°C (upper).
steps: Transmit a temperature value of -15.0°C to the THEMAS system.
Observe system temperature evaluation and output status.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS identifies the current temperature value as invalid and outputs an invalid temperature status.

test_cases.title: Temperature strictly greater than valid upper bound
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is configured with a valid temperature range of 0.0°C (lower) to 100.0°C (upper).
steps: Transmit a temperature value of 125.0°C to the THEMAS system.
Observe system temperature evaluation and output status.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS identifies the current temperature value as invalid and outputs an invalid temperature status.

test_cases.title: Boundary test - Value just below valid lower limit
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is configured with a valid temperature range lower limit of 0.0°C.
steps: Provide a temperature reading of -0.1°C (immediately below lower bound).
Verify system classification and generated status signal.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS identifies -0.1°C as an invalid temperature and outputs an invalid temperature status.

test_cases.title: Boundary test - Value exactly at valid lower limit
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is configured with a valid temperature range lower limit of 0.0°C.
steps: Provide a temperature reading of 0.0°C (exactly at lower bound).
Verify system classification and generated status signal.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS does not identify 0.0°C as invalid since it is not strictly less than the lower bound, and no invalid temperature status is output.

test_cases.title: Boundary test - Value exactly at valid upper limit
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is configured with a valid temperature range upper limit of 100.0°C.
steps: Provide a temperature reading of 100.0°C (exactly at upper bound).
Verify system classification and generated status signal.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS does not identify 100.0°C as invalid since it is not strictly greater than the upper bound, and no invalid temperature status is output.

test_cases.title: Boundary test - Value just above valid upper limit
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is configured with a valid temperature range upper limit of 100.0°C.
steps: Provide a temperature reading of 100.1°C (immediately above upper bound).
Verify system classification and generated status signal.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS identifies 100.1°C as an invalid temperature and outputs an invalid temperature status.

test_cases.title: Decision Table - Evaluation of disjunctive conditions for invalid status output
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is configured with valid temperature range bounds lower = L (0.0°C) and upper = U (100.0°C).
steps: Test Rule 1: Send input with Temp < L = True, Temp > U = False (e.g., -5.0°C).
Test Rule 2: Send input with Temp < L = False, Temp > U = True (e.g., 105.0°C).
test_cases.expected_result: For both Rule 1 and Rule 2 inputs, THEMAS satisfies the logical OR condition, identifies the temperature as invalid, and outputs an invalid temperature status.

final_text: If the current temperature value is strictly less than the lower value of the valid temperature range or if the received temperature value is strictly greater than the upper value of the valid temperature range, then the THEMAS system shall identify the current temperature value as an invalid temperature and shall output an invalid temperature status.
